[Intro]
[Dm]

[Verse 1]
[Dm]Here come old flattop, he come
grooving up slowly He got
juju eyeballs, he's one
holy roller He got
[A]hair down
to his knees
[G]Got to be a joker, he just
do what he please

[Bridge]
[Dm]

[Verse 2]
[Dm]He wear no shoeshine, he's got
toejam football He got
monkey finger, he shoot
CocaCola He say,
[A]"I know you,
you know me"
[G]One thing I can tell you is you
got to be free Come toge-

[Chorus]
[Bm]ther, [A]right
[G]now [A]Over me

[Interlude]
[Dm]

[Solo]
[Dm]

[Verse 3]
[Dm]He rollercoaster, he got
early warning He got
muddy water, he one
mojo filter He say,
[A]"One and one and o-
ne is three"
[G]Got to be good looking 'cause he's
so hard to see Come toge-

[Chorus]
[Bm]ther, [A]right
[G]now [A]Over me

[Bridge]
[Dm]
Come toge-

[Outro]
[Bm]ther, [A]right
[G]now [A]Come toge-
